test_GeminiAPI_generate_text: test the GeminiAPI backend to generate text with a prompt, stop sequences, and max tokens
test_GeminiAPI_cache: test the GeminiAPI backend to load and save response cache from a JSON file
test_GeminiAPI_chat: test the GeminiAPI backend to run a multi-turn chat with system, user, and model messages
test_GeminiAPI_multimodal: test the GeminiAPI backend to analyze an image and return a text description
test_GeminiAPI_response_schema: test the GeminiAPI backend to generate structured JSON output with response_schema and response_mime_type
